spec.name: Orange Kitchen Cookbook Panel
spec.description: An original leather-bound kitchen cookbook GUI with cream parchment, a stitched center fold, tiny utensil ornaments and a citrus seal. All 81 empty inset slots follow the requested coordinates. The title area is blank; everything outside the 176×222 panel is transparent.

prompt: Generate polished 256x256 Minecraft Java GUI pixel artwork for Orange SMP Kitchen, a mouse-clickable discoverable recipe cookbook. Exact layout critical: the active panel occupies x0..175,y0..221; pixels x176..255 or y222..255 MUST be transparent. Warm open illustrated cookbook, toasted brown leather edging, cream parchment pages, central stitched spine at x87, orange citrus corner seal, tiny cooking-themed edge ornamentation. Reserve title blank at x8,y6 width160 height10. Nine category slots at x8+18*n,y18,each16x16; leave clean background behind icons. Recipe grid 9 columns x3 rows at x8+18*n,y54/72/90,16x16 each. Bottom control row x8+18*n,y108. Player inventory slots x8+18*n,y140/158/176 and hotbar y198. These are 16x16 empty cream inset slots, no icons, no words. Rich restrained pixel material details, bevelled leather trim, page shadows, good readable contrast. Keep every content slot uncluttered. The entire background outside 176x222 transparent. Actual custom book design, never copy vanilla chest texture.
